title: catalog.product-deleted v1
description: A product was logically deleted and is no longer sellable. Consumers must ignore properties they do not know: adding one is a backward-compatible change.

eventId.description: Unique per occurrence; the message-id consumers deduplicate on.

aggregateVersion.description: Version of the aggregate after the change; detects gaps and reordering.

sku.description: The SKU the deleted product held, now released.
